headline: 🔴 Metabase Zero-Day Breaches Cloud Customers, 🎯 Storm-1175 Debuts StormEncryptor Ransomware, ⚠️ SCTPhantom Flaw Grants Root and Container Escape, 🎯 AI Slopsquatting Floods npm With 1,000 Packages, ⚠️ WordPress XSS2Shell Chains to Pre-Auth RCE, 🔴 North Carolina Ports Cyberattack Disrupts Cargo
summary: A Metabase SQLi zero-day breached cloud customers, Storm-1175 debuted StormEncryptor ransomware, and critical Linux kernel and WordPress flaws hit patch queues — alongside an AI slopsquatting wave that flooded npm with 1,000+ malicious packages.
